card.name: Words just before a following noun or number
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "to" after response, reactivity or exposure, and the space before a number such as 30 or 120 in time lists. Some other small linking words also fire.

modes.label: "to" after reaction nouns
modes.description: The word "to" after responses, reactivity or exposure, before a stimulus such as light, air or stimulation.
modes.example: pupillary reactivity<< to>> light is maintained

modes.label: Space before a time number
modes.description: A space token just before a number of minutes in sampling or infusion schedules.
modes.example: all subsequent CYRAMZA infusions may be administered over<< >>30 minutes
